title: Rotary Furnace
description: The &3Rotary Furnace&r is a large furnace which is powered by both &bSteam&r and &6&rsolid fuel. &rIt outputs molten material which can be cast similarly to the outputs of the &3Crucible&r and &3Arc Furnace&r. The Rotary Furnace is the only machine that can produce &6Saturnite&r and &6Weapon Steel&r.
